title: Local conditional expectation controller
statement: Let $D$ be a finite nonempty label set and let an input specify a finite constraint satisfaction problem together with a probability law on $D$ for each variable. The local controller is the state obtained by running the local conditional expectation procedure through the canonical list of all variables, starting from the input's initial state.
hypotheses_covered: An input for a constraint satisfaction template
